crmcustomfield.label: Recording Cleanup Pending
crmcustomfield.description: Sprint 2 U4 (HIGH-4) — set to T when the Twilio Recording DELETE fails transiently after a transcript is successfully saved. The scheduled poll runs a cleanup-retry pass over rows with this flag set and clears the flag on successful re-delete or confirmed 404. HIDDEN displaytype keeps this off the rep-facing UI; it's an operational diagnostic.
